verdict.rationale: Token2's own tools export some data in open formats: fido2-manage can dump device info and relying parties to JSON or CSV, and the TOTP toolset can export a seed as a CSV or JSON Entra ID import file. There is no evidence of a complete export of all user data, or of a documented migration path off Token2 keys. Missing for 10: documented full-data export covering all credentials and data types, an explicit exit or migration path, and independent corroboration.
